text:
DARE is Feng et al., **“Long-Sequence Recommendation Models Need Decoupled Embeddings” (ICLR 2025)**. It independently learns two tables: shared history/target attention embeddings A, and shared history/target representation embeddings R. It retrieves top-K histories by attention-space dot product, computes αᵢⱼ=softmaxᵢ(Aᵢ·Aⱼ/√dₐ), and aggregates target-aware interactions Σᵢαᵢⱼ(Rᵢ⊙Rⱼ) for prediction. Thus it separates selection from representation, beyond Q/K/V projections. Its TWIN-4E comparison additionally separates history/target roles in both spaces. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2410.02604v2)

For the proposed SASRec residual, Δs(j)=λΣᵢαᵢⱼ(Sᵢ·Tⱼ), A supplies symmetric pairwise selection logits, while independent source/target tables S,T permit directional transitions. This is a three-table hybrid, differing from DARE’s tied representation roles and interaction-vector prediction. [DIN](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.06978) already provides candidate-conditioned history pooling through an MLP activation unit, with unnormalized weights. [FPMC](https://www.iw3c2.org/papers/2025-Factorizing-Personalized-Markov-Chains.pdf) combines user–item preference with directional last-basket transitions. [FOSSIL](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1609.09152) combines normalized historical-item aggregation and personalized lag-weighted transitions using source/target factors; its aggregation weights are candidate-independent. Novelty therefore needs qualification: combining established mechanisms in a SASRec residual, rather than originating decoupling, target conditioning, or directional factors.

Suggested controls, not reported findings: cross candidate-conditioned versus candidate-independent learned pooling with tied versus independent S/T; add uniform, recency-only, and last-item pooling. Retrain controls and match total trainable capacity, including a wider SASRec and wider pooling residual. Tie A to ranking embeddings versus independent A, matching capacity separately. Keep history windows, loss, negatives, training budget and tuning allowance fixed. As inference diagnostics, replace attention queries with shuffled candidates or average weights while preserving S/T: degradation tests reliance on selection, but does not alone establish a training-time advantage.
